physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the thyroid, the small butterfly of a gland that wraps the front of the throat and sets the pace of the whole body's chemistry. Warmth, speed, the readiness to act, how steadily one can be among others without flagging, all of it is timed here. It is fitting. This is the code of the gathered group, and the thyroid is the body's own quiet conductor, the part that decides whether the chemistry can keep up with the room.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. When the climbing and the cowering the keys section spoke of take over, the throat tightens around them. The voice rises into the top of the chest, where dominance lives, or thins to almost nothing, where the lowered head lives. Either way the gland under that voice begins to carry the strain. Coldness in the hands. Tiredness that no sleep quite touches. A flatness in the metabolism that matches the flatness of being always slightly braced against the other people in the room.

The climb out is also bodily. Warmth returns to the throat first. The voice drops, lands lower in the chest, and stops needing to be above or below the room. The body sets a new pace, slower than the climb and faster than the cower, the pace of a person who is finally inside the group rather than above or beneath it. The gathering the card names is felt here, in the gland that lets the body keep time with the others.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the gland, this code answers to Cysteine. Cysteine carries sulfur, and sulfur is what the body uses to tie its strongest small bonds, the bridges that hold a protein in the shape it needs to do its work. Hair, nails, the lining that holds the body in, all leaning on these little links.

There is a teaching in that. The card is about a group finding its own order without anyone standing over it. Lower down, the chemistry is doing the same thing. Many small bonds, each one weak on its own, each one holding only its neighbour, and out of that the whole structure stands. No bond is in charge. None is above. The shape is the agreement between them. The synergy the keys section named runs all the way down to this: the body knows how to make a strong thing out of many small links that only do their job because the link beside them is doing its job too.
